rēcta: the feminine of the adjective rēctus (tībia rēcta), not Lewis & Short’s adverb rectā
fidē: the ablative of fidēs (Lewis & Short fĭdes), not the adverb fīdē
peditum: the genitive plural of pedes, peditis (Lewis & Short pĕdes), not the participle of pēdō
ōvīs: the ablative plural of ōvum, egg (Lewis & Short ōvum), not ovis, sheep
